title: Bias in LLMs as Annotators: The Effect of Party Cues on Labelling Decision by Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Randomly assigning different political party cues (extreme left, center-left, center-right, extreme right, or no cue) to immigration policy statements and using ordered logistic regression to measure the effect of these cues on the sentiment labels (positive, negative, or neutral) assigned by the LLMs.
